name: Hadamard matrix constructions through order 100
description: construct() -> 25 rows for orders 4,8,...,100. A row is None or an n-by-n matrix of Python integer signs -1/+1 satisfying H*H^T=n*I. Maximize the fraction of orders constructed. Every row product is checked exactly. These small orders have known solutions; this is a rediscovery task. Construct sign matrices for orders 4,8,...,100, maximizing order coverage. These orders already have constructions; no SageMath code or matrix data is copied.

state_of_the_art.statement: Hadamard matrices of every order 4k up to 664 are known (668 is the smallest open order), so all 25 orders up to 100 can be constructed. Order 92 was the last of them, found by Baumert, Golomb and Hall.
